import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
inp=G['Demo pair 2 input']; out=G['Demo pair 2 output']
# check mapping: find nonzero cells in input and corresponding color in output region
def seg(g, sep=0):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); R=[]
    r=0
    while r<H:
        if g[r][r//0]==sep if False else any(x==sep for x in g[r]):
            pass
        s=r
        while r<H and any(x!=sep for x in g[r]): r+=1
        R.append((s,r))
    C=[]; c=0
    while c<W:
        e=c
        while e<W and all(g[0][e]==sep or True for _ in [0]): e+=1
        break
    return R,C
# simpler: identify separator rows (all zero) and cols
H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
sepr=[i for i in range(H) if all(x==0 for x in inp[i])]
sepc=[j for j in range(W) if all(inp[i][j]==0 for i in range(H))]
print('rows',sepr,'cols',sepc)

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    zr=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==0 for x in g[r])]
    zc=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==0 for r in range(H))]
    def grp(n,z):
        res=[];i=0
        while i<n:
            j=i+1
            while j<n and j not in z: j+=1
            res.append((i,j-1)); i=j
        return res
    rgs=grp(H,zr);cgs=grp(W,zc)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for (r0,r1) in rgs:
        for (c0,c1) in cgs:
            mk=[(v,rr-r0,cc-c0) for rr in range(r0,r1+1) for cc in range(c0,c1+1) for v in[g[rr][cc]] if v not in (0,5)]
            assert len(mk)==1,(mk,g)
            col=(mk[0][0]+5)%10
            for r in range(r0,r1+1):
                for c in range(c0,c1+1):
                    if out[r][c] not in (0,): out[r][c]=col
    return out
